description:
Traffic in a street of Calapan city, Philippines. 
I made this recording near a downtown street of Calapan city (Oriental Mindoro, Philippines), standing just in front of Nuciti Mall, which shall open a few minutes later. 
One can hear quite heavy traffic with lots of vehicles (cars, motorcycles, some trucks and some jeepneys) passing by and onking at times, as well as the voices of some people in the street.  
Recorded in July 2025 with a Zoom H6essential (built-in XY microphones). 
Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
